question: Will the price of HYPE break $100 before Oct 30, 2026 (market close)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the HYPE/USDT price on Binance reaches or exceeds $100.00 at any point before the market's closing time (Oct 30, 2026, 10:00 AM EST).
- "No": Wins if the HYPE/USDT price on Binance remains below $100.00 at all times up to and including the market's closing time (Oct 30, 2026, 10:00 AM EST).

Clarifications:
- "Breaks $100" is interpreted as the HYPE/USDT spot price on Binance touching or exceeding 100.00 USDT on any trade or at any observed price point (not only at close) before the market's closing time.
